title: Trader Diary: When SOXLB decides to party
content:
9 PM: Spot BTC barely moves, I'm scrolling memes.
10 PM: SOXLB spikes +23% like it just found the cheat code.
11 PM: Me, checking my 1‑minute chart like it’s a love interest, then closing all positions before I even remember why I opened them.
lesson: If a token’s jump feels like a fireworks show, remember: fireworks are fun to watch, not to hold.
question: Who else rode the SOXLB rollercoaster and survived the loop‑de‑loop? Share your best meme reaction 👇
